$meta.citation: Pickup, T. (2026). The Financial Case for Local Government Reorganisation in Lancashire: A Transparent Component Model of Four Proposals and Two Single-Council Forms, with a Postscript on the 2026 Decisions. Working paper, v3.2. Zenodo.
$meta.title: The Financial Case for Local Government Reorganisation in Lancashire: A Transparent Component Model of Four Proposals and Two Single-Council Forms, with a Postscript on the 2026 Decisions
$meta.note: Working paper, not peer reviewed. Steady-state net annual position and ten-year NPV at 3.5% (2024-25 prices), for 2, 3, 4 and 5 unitaries and two single-council forms that no council proposed (one new council for the whole area, 1UA; the county council with its twelve districts, 1UA (county+12)). Structural effects only: transformation savings are excluded. The model's ordering favours fewer councils by construction. The author is a Cabinet member of Lancashire County Council, which proposed two unitaries and would be the continuing authority under one of the single-council forms; see the paper's Declaration of Interests.
